title: Cancel Order (Inventory Restock, Framework-Free)
instructions: The original Django task is rebuilt on an in-memory `Store` (see `ecom/store.py`, read-only). Implement `OrderServiceImpl.cancel_order` in `ecom/services/order_service_impl.py` and `OrderController.cancel_order` in `ecom/controllers/order_controller.py`. Raise `UserNotFoundError`, `OrderNotFoundError` (also when the order belongs to someone else) and `OrderCannotBeCancelledError` unless the order is `PLACED`; otherwise restock every item and mark the order `CANCELLED`. Use `store.transaction()` so two concurrent cancellations cannot both restock.

evidence.label: Cancelling a PLACED order adds every item back to its inventory and marks it CANCELLED
An unknown user raises UserNotFoundError and an unknown order raises OrderNotFoundError
An order that belongs to another user raises OrderNotFoundError and stays untouched
SHIPPED, DELIVERED and CANCELLED orders raise OrderCannotBeCancelledError and restock nothing
A second cancellation fails and the stock is restored only once
Eight concurrent cancellations of one order succeed exactly once
Controller returns SUCCESS with the order, or FAILURE without raising
